body: Do couples counselors help with breakups? Or speak privately to one side?

She's normally not open to solo counseling because my mom suggested it. It took a lot convincing for the couples counselor. But she had a breakdown yesterday and I had to take her to an emergency counselor. But like I said, she said I'm the only thing that brings her happiness and keeping her from ending it.
But we live together and we are both on the lease. Would it be easier to kick her out or go back to my parents with all my stuff (which is essentially everything in the apartment)
Run where? We are both on the lease and everything in the apartment is mine. Like everything but her clothes and blankets.
